title: How to stream a DJI drone on Kick (stream URL and key)
description: Stream a DJI drone live on Kick: copy the stream URL and key from the Kick dashboard, add them as a custom RTMP destination in DJI Live Bridge, and go live.
h1: How to stream a DJI drone on Kick
lead: In the Kick creator dashboard open Settings → Stream URL & Key, copy both into a Custom RTMP destination in DJI Live Bridge, send the drone's picture from DJI Fly to the app, and press START LIVE. Kick uses an encrypted RTMPS address, which the app supports.
summary: Kick is added as a Custom RTMP destination with the Stream URL and Stream key from the Kick dashboard.
Kick's stream URL is an rtmps:// address; always copy it from your own dashboard.
Kick may ask you to turn on two-factor authentication before it shows the key.
Use Horizontal 16:9 for a 1920×1080 stream at 30 fps and 6 Mbps.
The same picture can go to Kick and other platforms at once.

sections.h2: Stream to Kick, step by step

steps.d: In DJI Fly open GO FLY → ••• → Transmission → Live Streaming Platforms → RTMP and enter the address DJI Live Bridge shows.

steps.t: Copy the stream URL and key
steps.d: On kick.com open the creator dashboard → Settings → Stream URL & Key. Copy the Stream URL (it starts with rtmps:// and ends in /app) and the Stream key.
In DJI Live Bridge choose Custom RTMP, name it Kick and paste both values.
The channel goes live when Kick receives the stream. Set the title and category in the dashboard; press End stream in the app to finish.

head: Setting
Value
rows: H.264, 6 Mbps CBR, keyframe every 2 seconds

list: The key is hidden: turn on two-factor authentication in your Kick account settings, then reopen the page.
Connection failed: copy the stream URL again including rtmps://, the port and /app.
The key was shared by mistake: reset it on Kick and update it in the app.

faq.q: Can I stream a DJI drone on Kick?
faq.a: Yes. Send DJI Fly's RTMP stream to DJI Live Bridge and add Kick as a Custom RTMP destination with the stream URL and key from your Kick dashboard.
Yes, Kick's stream URL is an rtmps:// address, and DJI Live Bridge accepts rtmps:// destinations.

faq.q: Can I stream to Kick and Twitch at the same time?
faq.a: DJI Live Bridge can send to both at once. Check each platform's current rules on simulcasting first.

faq.q: Is DJI Live Bridge affiliated with Kick?
faq.a: No. It is an independent, free and open-source app.
